ACCOLADES

I’ve been recognized across global film festivals. Accolades include an Official Selection for Absorber at LA Shorts International Film Festival, an Oscar-qualifying festival (2026), Best Documentary Short at LA Film Awards (2020), Best Commercial at Top Shorts (2020), and Webby Honoree for Branded Sports Content (2021). Work featured in Shots, Little Black Book, and Shoot Online. Emmy-nominated for Main Title Design, and honored by the Clios, CAANZ AXIS, and Ciclope.

BIO

Noah is a filmmaker and artist whose work explores stories where psyche and pressure collide. He directs visually driven, cinematic films that use bold image-making to express identity, tension, and transformation, working across authored narrative and high-end branded storytelling.

Drawing from a background in film, writing, music, and design, Noah approaches filmmaking as a picture-driven discipline rooted in meaning. His work is defined by precision, movement, and rhythm, using framing, color, and composition not as decoration, but as active tools to shape emotion and perspective. His films feel controlled, kinetic, and deliberately designed to be felt as much as understood.

At the center of Noah’s work is a deep sensitivity to human presence. He has a natural eye for faces and physicality, building stories around performance, restraint, and emotional truth. Whether working with athletes, artists, or actors, he uses his distinct visual language to capture moments of self-definition; where interior experience becomes visible.

Noah has directed projects for brands including BMW, HOKA, Red Bull, ASICS, Under Armour, Nike, Adidas, Bullish and General Motors to name a few. His work for these category-defining brands demonstrates his ability to merge striking imagery with confident, contemporary commercial storytelling. He also directed the short film ABSORBER, a meditation on desire and its cost.

Whether working in commercial or narrative spaces, Noah is guided by a single question: what does this story feel like? His films answer through image, rhythm, and performance by grounding ambitious ideas in precise human moments.

Process is central to Noah’s approach. He begins with the idea, the people, and the stakes, allowing the project’s vernacular to emerge organically through collaboration. He creates environments where rigor and openness coexist, where strong ideas are challenged, craft is respected, and integrity is never sacrificed for spectacle.

Noah is based in Los Angeles, works globally, and is currently developing his feature film, DAWN, under his ENTiTY Films project.
